name: King of Ai
overview: The King of Ai was a male ruler during the time of the conquest of the Land, as recorded in Joshua 8:1. There is no specific tribal affiliation or additional notes about him in Scripture. His role is tied to a significant period in Israel's history when God was leading His people to possess the Promised Land.
namesAndTitles: The title 'King of Ai' means simply 'king of the Ai,' indicating his authority over the city of Ai. This is a descriptive title rather than a personal name, and it was not given by God but used to identify his position in the biblical narrative.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for the King of Ai beyond what is noted in his title and role during the conquest. No relatives or descendants are mentioned in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: The King of Ai represents the opposition to God's people during the conquest of Canaan. His presence in the narrative highlights the challenges Israel faced in claiming the land promised by God. Through the defeat of Ai and its king, God's faithfulness and power to fulfill His promises are demonstrated within the unfolding history of redemption.
